definitions.explanation: Large in number. Usually placed before the noun ({数多|かずおお}い〜 / {数多|かずおお}くの〜), and slightly more formal than {多|おお}い.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、ついに⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He overcame many difficulties and finally made his dream come true.

notes:
⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧ (number) + ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (many). The adverbial form {数多|かずおお}く, above all in {数多|かずおお}くの〜 (many …), is far more common than the plain form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: many …, numerous …
- {数多|かずおお}く⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave many (works, records)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: many, a lot, the everyday word, mostly used as a predicate
- ⟦{数少|かずすく}ない→数少ない：32229_kazusukunai⟧: few, rare, the opposite
- ⟦{数多|あまた}→数多：15498_amata⟧: many, a literary word with the same kanji

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {数多|かずおお}くなかったら
